description:
The Acme X1 platform support pack, provided by Acme Microsystems, offers a complete set of peripherals and tools for the Acme X1 device. It is identified by the name **AcmeX1** and described as “Acme X1 platform support pack providing peripherals and tools.” The pack follows the build configuration macro **ACME_X1**, is released as version **1.2.3**, and is distributed under the **MIT License**. The primary documentation is a built‑in PDF located at **docs/acme_x1_manual.pdf**, while the core description file (not built‑in) can be found at **core/acme_x1_core.yaml**. Peripheral register information is supplied in the SVD file **svd/acme_x1.svd**, and the OpenOCD configuration is a built‑in file at **openocd/acme_x1.cfg**. The platform launches using the **OpenOCD** configuration, and the recommended GDB auto‑run command is “target remote localhost:3333”. Connections to OpenOCD may use any free TCP/IP port, as the setting is **auto**. This is a silicon platform (not FPGA), and the trace encoder should be configured with the string “trace_enable=1;trace_clock=100MHz”.

Library files are located in the **libs/** directory, and header files reside in the **include/** directory of the unpacked package. For remote debugging, the target host is **192.168.1.100** with the username **debugger**. All of these resources together constitute the complete Acme X1 support pack ready for integration into the Catapult IDE.
